# v0.2.8 release evidence

`publication.json` binds the authorized crates.io/GitHub release to annotated
tag `v0.2.8` and clean commit `18020190b1c80037442be29d74e90fd9e07253e0`.
The exact-source full CI selection, native command coverage, complete logs,
local/Linux distribution reports, downloaded artifacts, registry installation,
live pinned links and actual docs.rs build are recorded here. Raw command logs
use lossless gzip; publication.json maps original paths and both byte hashes.

Earlier development reports remain unchanged historical evidence. Final release
checks cover the later source identity, and repair the observed diagnostic/test
and packaging-reference failures before publication. Publication evidence and
status views are committed after the immutable release tag.

The older-macOS fallback was forced in tests and the existing 10.12 deployment
target was compiled; no physical old-macOS runtime validation is claimed.
Rust remains authoritative; external schemas and general theorem gates remain
open. Further #223 consolidation/performance work was excluded. No PyPI/custom
binary publication or new maximum-size corpus benchmark was performed.
